entry.title: RT ELON CLIPS: Elon Musk: The sun provides basically 100% of the energy in the solar system. “One way to look at civilization is progress on the Kard...
entry.summary: RT ELON CLIPS Elon Musk: The sun provides basically 100% of the energy in the solar system. “One way to look at civilization is progress on the Kardashev scale. Kardashev scale 1 means you've harnessed all the power of a planet. I think we've probably harnessed less than 1% of the power of Earth. Kardashev scale 2 is you've harnessed all the power of your sun. The sun is overwhelmingly the largest source of energy in the solar system. Everything else maybe amounts to about a trillionth of the energy in the solar system, compared to the sun. So, it rounds up to 100%. That's how much of the energy in the future will be solar, when you view things from a Kardashev standpoint.” Future Investment Initiative Conference, October 29, 2024
